<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 211.0764, which in positive‑mode ESI most likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈210.069 Da. A formula that matches this mass within a few millidaltons is C₁₁H₁₄O₂S (calculated exact mass 210.0715 Da). This fits the required format CxHyOzX with X = S.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H14O2S</final_answer>
